blocks.instruction: Leia o texto e escolha a alternativa correta. Algumas perguntas pedem inferência — a resposta não está escrita com todas as letras.
blocks.passage:
In the UK, work and life are two different things. Most offices go quiet at 5:30. After that, people go home. Weekends are for family, hobbies, gardens and pubs.

Emails arrive sometimes, but no one expects a reply at 10 p.m. In August, many offices almost empty out. Holidays are real holidays — not 'work from the beach'.

This balance is part of British professionalism. It is not laziness. People who protect their free time often deliver the most over a full year.

items.q: What time do most UK offices go quiet?
items.why: "Most offices go quiet at 5:30."

items.q: What are weekends for, according to the text?
items.why: "Weekends are for family, hobbies, gardens and pubs."

items.q: What happens to many offices in August?
items.why: "In August, many offices almost empty out."

items.q: If you send an email at 10 p.m., the author suggests you should…
options: send it again in the morning
not expect a reply that night
items.why: Inferência: "no one expects a reply at 10 p.m." — mandar é ok, esperar resposta não.

items.q: The author would most likely DISAGREE with which idea?
options: Free time helps people work well.
People who rest a lot are lazy.
items.why: Inferência: o texto diz que proteger o tempo livre é profissionalismo, não preguiça.

blocks.instruction: Ouça Emily falar com uma nova colega sobre o fim de semana. Responda sem ler a transcrição — ela só aparece depois de corrigir.

audio.text:
Hi, welcome to the team! I saw your email to Tom this morning. Don't worry — he will answer it on Monday.

It's Friday afternoon now, and here in the UK we switch off at the weekend. Tom is a good manager, but weekends are for his family and his garden. He rarely reads work emails on Saturday or Sunday.

I know your question feels urgent. But it can wait two days. Nothing will break. On Monday morning, Tom will read it and reply fast.

This is normal here. Offices go quiet at 5:30, and August is very quiet too. People take real holidays and they switch off.

So enjoy your first weekend. Rest, see your friends, do something fun. On Monday you will be fresh, and the work will still be here. That's how we do it in Britain.
audio.label: Ouça quantas vezes precisar. A transcrição aparece depois de corrigir.

items.q: When will Tom answer the new colleague's email?
items.why: "he will answer it on Monday."

items.q: What does Tom do on the weekend?
options: He is with his family and garden
items.why: "weekends are for his family and his garden."

items.q: How often does Tom read work emails on Saturday or Sunday?
items.why: "He rarely reads work emails on Saturday or Sunday."

items.q: Emily thinks the urgent question…
options: can wait until Monday without a problem
items.why: Inferência: "it can wait two days. Nothing will break."

items.q: What is Emily's main advice to the new colleague?
options: Wait at the office for Tom
Work all weekend to look good
items.why: Inferência: ela diz para descansar e aproveitar — o trabalho estará lá na segunda.

blocks.instruction: O vocabulário da lição aparece aqui em frases novas. Escolha o sentido ou a palavra que cabe no contexto.

items.q: "After a long week, I need to switch off and relax." To switch off means to…
items.why: To switch off = desligar-se, parar de pensar no trabalho.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "My ___ is next week, so I will be at the beach with my family."
items.why: Holiday = férias/feriado — o tempo de descanso longe do trabalho.

items.q: "A good boundary keeps work and home life apart." A boundary is…
items.why: Boundary = limite, uma linha entre duas coisas.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "On the ___, I like to work in my garden and see friends."
items.why: Weekend = fim de semana — sábado e domingo.

items.q: "We must protect our free time." To protect means to…
items.why: To protect = proteger, manter algo seguro.

blocks.instruction: Expressões comuns em e-mails e reuniões de trabalho. Escolha o sentido no contexto.

items.q: "I need to switch off this weekend." This means to…
items.why: Switch off = desligar-se do trabalho, descansar.

items.q: "My manager is out of office until Monday." This means she is…
items.why: Out of office = fora do escritório, ausente do trabalho.

items.q: "Let's catch up on Monday." This means let's…
items.why: Catch up = colocar a conversa em dia, atualizar-se.

items.q: "Don't worry, it can wait until Monday." This means it…
items.why: It can wait until = pode esperar, não é urgente agora.

items.q: "I'll get back to you tomorrow." This means I will…
items.why: Get back to = retornar, responder mais tarde.
